source_consistency_flags: PRISMA prose says 503 records were removed, while Figure 1 shows 503 remained after 721 duplicates were removed from 1,224 records.
Results says included studies were published 2017-2022; Table 1 includes EMPA-REG OUTCOME (2015) and labels DECLARE-TIMI 58 as 2009.
HF MACE sotagliflozin-vs-dapagliflozin CI is 0.58-0.92 in the main article and 0.57-0.92 in the supplement.
Supplement CANVAS summary says n=17,160, while main Table 1 arm counts total n=10,142.
Supplement CANVAS amputation HR 1.97 is printed with 95% CI 1.41-1.75, an interval that does not contain the point estimate.
